title: Minneapolis Titanic: An Immersive Voyage Entry Ticket
includes: Explore 100+ Titanic artifacts & historical displays. Step inside Titanic-inspired room recreations.
Optional VIP upgrade which includes a VR wreck site exploration and a poster
Explore immersive Titanic projections. Encounter a towering iceberg and interactive lifeboat exhibit
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Titanic: An Immersive Voyage transports visitors back to 1912 through immersive galleries, recreated spaces, artifacts, projections, and interactive storytelling.

Guests explore the ship’s construction, walk recreated interiors, learn about passenger and crew stories, and experience the dramatic events surrounding the voyage.

The exhibition combines historical artifacts, multimedia environments, large-scale immersive projections, 3D visuals, and interactive experiences to provide an educational and emotional journey through one of history’s most iconic events.

Upgrade to the VIP experiences which include a virtual reality expedition exploring the Titanic wreck site more than 2.5 miles beneath the ocean surface.
